comment: Single source of truth for what a shipped Windows bundle must contain. The release workflow verifies the built ZIP against this list, and a Rust test verifies that the same list describes a bundle the application accepts.
notes: README-WINDOWS.txt is also the marker the application uses to recognise a packaged bundle; without it a missing backend would be treated as a developer machine instead of a packaging fault.
The model itself ships as a separate model pack asset and is unpacked into whisper/. The main archive is therefore usable for a self-test before the model is downloaded.

sciwhisper-updater.exe replaces the installation after the application exits. Windows cannot rename the directory holding a running executable, so without this helper an update can be downloaded and verified and then never installed.
